title: HYBRID-TAPER23: logarithmically offset two-thirds switch improves the full time prefactor

claims.statement: For EVERY N>=2 and secret s,n=ceil(log2N),the SINGLE HYBRID-TAPER23 algorithm of proof.md/nonpower_merge.md recovers the ENTIRE secret with unconditional success>=1-2^-8 on independent ideal copies. Mainn>=2^48 uses rceil(sqrt n),q141421/100000,mceil(qr),kappaceilLogm+1,baseceil((100759/28284200000)r),upliftceil(2kappa/3)+2,dlbase+uplift,Hbase+m-1,Lfloor(m/(4uplift)),exact integer taper,early h0ceil2m/3+24u full-power merges,real transition range projection,late v=m-h0 weighted deficitsdelta_j=(j+1)2^(j-v-sigma),sigmaceilLogv+2,final full2 root. Staged bootstrap and signed-near-parity/twoadic bit decoding are reproduced. All FOUR bounds hold JOINTLY on EVERY branch, including retries,rejected/discarded copies,projectionFAILs,addresses,table initialization,exact arithmetic,circuit generation,lookups,gates,measurements,resets and source charges.
